project_metadata.name: Legal Docs App v2
project_metadata.stack: Next.js 16, TypeScript, React 19, LowDB, Workflow (Durable Execution)

patterns.name: RESTful CRUD Pattern
patterns.description: Consistent REST API pattern across all entities (Users, Companies, Documents, Packages) with GET, POST, PUT/PATCH, DELETE operations
patterns.usage: All API routes follow Next.js App Router pattern with route handlers (GET, POST) that return NextResponse.json() with standardized { success, data/error } structure

implementation_details.response_format: { success: boolean, data?: T, error?: string }

patterns.name: Workflow Orchestration Pattern
patterns.description: Durable workflow execution pattern using 'workflow' package for long-running document generation processes
patterns.usage: Document generation uses durable workflows with 'use workflow' and 'use step' directives for fault-tolerant multi-step processes

implementation_details.workflow_structure: Main workflow with sub-steps (loadRequiredData, generateContent, updateDocumentContent)
implementation_details.durability: Workflow state persisted via .well-known protocol endpoints
implementation_details.fault_tolerance: Automatic retries and state recovery on failures

patterns.name: File-Based JSON Database Pattern
patterns.description: LowDB with JSONFile adapter for persistent local-first data storage
patterns.usage: All entities stored in single JSON file with in-memory caching and async read/write operations

implementation_details.schema_structure: DatabaseSchema with users, companies, documents, packages, templates, settings, sessions
implementation_details.persistence_strategy: Lazy initialization with schema validation on first access
implementation_details.transaction_pattern: Read entire DB, modify in memory, write back with db.write()

patterns.name: Multi-Step Survey Pattern with AI Assistance
patterns.description: Wizard-style form with contextual AI chat assistant for form filling
patterns.usage: 5-step survey flow with real-time AI suggestions that populate form fields

implementation_details.ai_integration: Chat API provides suggestions that auto-fill survey fields
implementation_details.state_management: React useState for survey data accumulation across steps

patterns.name: Template Variable Substitution Pattern
patterns.description: Multi-format placeholder replacement system for document generation
patterns.usage: Supports [Placeholder], {{placeholder}}, [[placeholder]] formats with company data mapping

implementation_details.processing: RegExp-based pattern matching with batch replacement

patterns.name: Cookie-Based Session Authentication
patterns.description: Bcrypt password hashing with session tokens stored in HTTP-only cookies
patterns.usage: Login creates session, stores in cookie, middleware validates on protected routes

implementation_details.session_storage: UUID tokens in database with 24-hour expiration

protocols.name: Next.js App Router API Protocol
protocols.description: Next.js 16 App Router convention for API route handlers
protocols.usage: Export async GET/POST/PUT/DELETE functions that receive Request and return Response

protocols.name: Workflow Durable Execution Protocol
protocols.description: Standard workflow protocol for durable execution with .well-known endpoints
protocols.usage: Workflow runtime communicates with app via standardized .well-known protocol endpoints

standards.name: JSON API Response Standard
standards.description: Consistent API response envelope across all endpoints
standards.usage: All API responses follow ApiResponse<T> or PaginatedResponse<T> structure

implementation_details.success_response: { success: true, data: T, metadata?: { timestamp, requestId } }
implementation_details.error_response: { success: false, error: { code, message, field?, details? } }
implementation_details.pagination: { items: T[], total, page, limit, totalPages }

standards.name: TypeScript Enum Convention
standards.description: PascalCase enums with UPPER_CASE values for type safety
standards.usage: All entity types, statuses, and field types defined as TypeScript enums

standards.name: ISO 8601 DateTime Standard
standards.description: All timestamps stored as ISO 8601 strings
standards.usage: createdAt, updatedAt, expiresAt fields use new Date().toISOString()

standards.name: TypeScript Strict Mode
standards.description: Full TypeScript type safety with explicit interfaces
standards.usage: All data structures have TypeScript interfaces, no implicit any types

implementation_details.type_exports: Export all types from contracts for reuse

integrations.name: LowDB JSON Database Integration
integrations.description: Local-first JSON file database with async operations
integrations.usage: Singleton pattern with getDb() function, all CRUD operations async

integrations.name: OpenAI Chat API Integration (Planned)
integrations.description: AI-powered chat assistant for form filling and document generation
integrations.usage: Currently mock responses, designed for OpenAI integration

implementation_details.suggestion_mechanism: AI returns field_id: value pairs for auto-population
implementation_details.context_passing: Full survey data sent to AI for contextual responses

integrations.name: Workflow Durable Execution Integration
integrations.description: Durable workflow execution for long-running document generation
integrations.usage: start(workflow, args) initiates durable execution with automatic persistence

implementation_details.step_functions: Separate async functions with 'use step' for resumability
implementation_details.utilities: sleep() for delays, automatic retry on failure
implementation_details.execution_tracking: workflowRunId stored in document for status queries

integrations.name: Custom Cookie-Based Auth System
integrations.description: Self-contained authentication without external auth providers
integrations.usage: Login/signup creates session, middleware checks getCurrentUser()

implementation_details.session_mechanism: UUID tokens in database with expiration
implementation_details.logout: Session deletion from database and cookie removal

architectural_insights.overall_architecture: Monolithic Next.js application with local-first JSON database and durable workflow execution

key_design_decisions.rationale: Local-first, zero-config, file-based persistence for MVP/prototype
key_design_decisions.tradeoffs: Limited query capabilities, single-file bottleneck, but simple deployment

key_design_decisions.rationale: Document generation needs fault tolerance and long-running process support
key_design_decisions.tradeoffs: Additional complexity, but enables reliable async workflows

key_design_decisions.decision: Next.js App Router with Route Handlers
key_design_decisions.rationale: Modern Next.js pattern, collocated API routes, TypeScript-first
key_design_decisions.tradeoffs: Newer API, less middleware ecosystem than Pages Router

key_design_decisions.rationale: Simpler server-side session invalidation, HTTP-only security
key_design_decisions.tradeoffs: Server-side lookup required, but more secure than localStorage JWT
Limited formatting options vs DOCX/PDF, but easy to maintain

scalability_considerations.current_limitation: Single JSON file with full read/write on every operation
scalability_considerations.migration_path: Replace LowDB with PostgreSQL/Supabase, keep same interface pattern
Add NextAuth.js or Clerk for social logins and enterprise SSO
Integrate OpenAI API with streaming responses and token management

scalability_considerations.current_limitation: Generated content stored in database as strings
scalability_considerations.migration_path: Move to S3/cloud storage with CDN for large documents

code_quality_metrics.type_safety: High - Explicit interfaces for all data structures
code_quality_metrics.error_handling: Consistent - Try-catch with proper status codes
code_quality_metrics.code_organization: Clean - Lib, components, app directories separated
code_quality_metrics.reusability: High - Shared contracts, utilities, UI components
